sources.title: NanoChat · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NanoChat is a compact decoder-only transformer model designed for educational purposes and efficient training. The model features several fundamental architectural innovations which are common in modern transformer models. Therefore, it is a good model to use as a starting point to understand the principles of modern transformer models.
